_comment: The shipped text-and-curation layer. Curation, groups and prose are authored here; classes, properties and defaults are generated on the user's machine from their install. The enemyStats block was imported once from the legacy ModMaker PHP by ModMakerCatalogSpike/extract-enemy-ui.py and is edited here from now on - the legacy source is never read again.

groups.title: Projectiles
groups.description: Global projectile behaviour. Mostly unnamed in the game; pages are titled from the class name.

groups.title: Not Recognised
groups.description: Discovered in your install but unknown to this version of ModMaker - usually content from another mod. Editable, but with no descriptions.

SFXProjectile.reason: Abstract base plus 92 subclasses, no TLK names anywhere. In for global projectile changes; pages fall back to the class name.

SFXCustomAction.reason: 607 classes averaging 2.4 properties, none named - animation stubs, not tunable content. Individual exceptions are listed in `curation`.

sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.reason: the old app had a page for this (powers, matched on display name)

sfxgamempcontent.sfxwave_horde_cerberus.reason: eleven wave instances, not a form page

sfxgamempcontent.sfxdifficultyhandlermp.reason: 2,455 stat values behind four array properties

sfxgame.bioworldinfo.reason: the multiplayer bot settings; the other eleven own properties are conversation, camera, PS3 and single-player leftovers

sfxgame.bioglobalvariabletable.reason: 82 own properties, all of them the ME1/ME2 plot import table - single-player, and nothing a multiplayer mod can use

sfxgamecontentdlc_con_mp5.sfxcustomactio.reason: the SFXCustomAction family is excluded wholesale, but the old app really did have a page for this one

cooldowntime.label: Recharge Time

impactradius.label: Radius
impactradius.text: How far from the point of impact the effect reaches.

sfxgamecontent.sfxpowercustomaction_pull.descriptionAppend: Pull's cooldown starts when the target is released, not when the power is cast.

sfxgame.bioworldinfo/m_nAutoBotMPKit.label: Bot Kit
sfxgame.bioworldinfo/m_nAutoBotMPKit.description: Which multiplayer kit the auto-bot plays as when it fills an empty slot.

_factionsComment: Keyed by the wavelist's config SECTION. 'title' is what the faction is called. Milan names the Retaliation lists by their class suffix - Cerberus2, Geth2 - so the titles say that rather than prettifying it into something nobody uses; the base lists are Cerberus, Geth, Reapers. 'enemyPrefix' is the tag its enemy types carry, WAVE_CER_Centurion, which is not derivable from the name: CER is Cerberus, RPR is Reapers, GTH is Geth. A mod that adds a faction ships this for itself in DLC_MOD_Whatever/ModMaker/textlayer.json rather than waiting for ModMaker to learn about it.
_classTextComment: Keyed by config SECTION, lower case, e.g. sfxgamecontent.sfxweapon_ai_cannibalrifle. 'description' is shown on that thing's editor page in place of whatever the game says. Weapons the game never described - turrets, enemy-only guns - inherit a shared placeholder from SFXWeapon, and their pages say so and name the key to add here. Anything written here is ModMaker's own text: it is labelled as such in the editor and is NOT compiled into the mod, so it needs no TLK entry and no string ref.

Abomination.title: Abomination
Abomination.intro: These settings affect the Abomination, a very dangerous unit with low health that explodes when killed. The possessed version is extremely dangerous.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Possession Bonuses
groups.description: Sets the bonuses the Abomination gets when becoming possessed.

groups.title: Possessed Barrier Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the Possessed Abomination barrier regenerates.

groups.title: Death Explosion
groups.description: The Abomination explodes on death and when it wins a sync melee fight. Headshots will prevent explosions.

groups.title: Possessed Death Explosion
groups.description: The Possessed Abomination has a very large detonation on death and when it wins a sync melee fight. Headshots will prevent explosions. The explosion delay is shared with the standard Death Explosion.

groups.title: Explosion Friendly Fire
groups.description: The Abomination explosion hurts allies in a damage multiplier.

groups.title: Flare Mode
groups.description: When an Abomination is close to an enemy it enters Flare Mode, where speed and damage are increased.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Defines the cooldown on the arm swipe attack.

groups.title: Sync Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Defines the cooldown on the synced melee attack where you must fight them off. The sync attack follows a melee attack. If the abomination is not fought off within a few seconds, it explodes.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Atlas.title: Original Atlas
Atlas.intro: These settings affect the Atlas, a devasting Cerberus unit with rockets, smoke grenades, and tons of armor. This page affects the original Atlas, which is used in SP and in MP if you select it or fight on the original, unmodified wavelists.

groups.title: Armor
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Shields
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit's shields will deflect before health can be damaged.

groups.title: Shield Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the Atlas shield regenerates.

groups.title: Smoke Grenade Frequency
groups.description: Sets the cooldown between smoke grenade shots in terms of seconds. Only 2 smoke grenades can be active at any given time.

groups.title: Rocket Attack
groups.description: Sets the cooldown rocket launches. Due to the way the Atlas gun works, the rocket will not fire much faster than standard gameplay.

groups.title: Cockpit Block
groups.description: When the Atlas is taking significant amounts of damage in a short period of time it can raise its arm to protect the cockpit. In multiplayer this effectively does nothing as there is no driver by default.

groups.title: Armor Pieces
groups.description: Armor pieces on the Atlas can be destroyed, allowing you to do more damage in exposed areas.

groups.title: Glass Cockpit
groups.description: Sets the health for the glass cockpit on the Atlas. When it is destroyed the Atlas is staggered. Without more complex modding, this effectively does nothing.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the arm swing and ground pound attack.

groups.title: Sync Kill Chance
groups.description: Sets the chance the Atlas will perform a sync kill (instant kill) if you are in range following a melee attack. The sync kill action has its own cooldown.

Husk.intro: These settings affect the Reaper Husk, a zombie like unit which specializes in swarming players and distracting.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Defines the cooldown on the arm swipe attack.

groups.title: Sync Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Defines the cooldown on the synced melee attack where you must fight them off. The sync attack follows a melee attack.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

groups.title: Health & Shields
groups.description: Kai Leng's shield recharges automatically at 40% and 10%. It does not recharge on its own like all other shields do.

groups.title: Power Slash
groups.description: Kai Leng has a biotic slash attack that is very similar to the one in multiplayer.

groups.title: Melee Attacks
groups.description: Kai Leng does sword slashes and synced melee attacks like the Phantom. The Sync attack is a quick time event, which results in death if you lose.

groups.title: Aggressive Mode
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the "aggressive" state of the Kai Leng, where he tries to close distance to his target and attack with his melee.

groups.title: Reaction Triggers
groups.description: Kai Leng will automatically perform a reaction when a certain amount of damage is dealt. When close to the damage source he will be knocked back, if he is farther away he will roll.

Marauder.title: Marauder
Marauder.intro: These settings affect the Marauder, a squad leader Reaper unit with a phaeston, buffing abilities, and elbows of adamantium.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Shields
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit's shields will deflect before health can be damaged.

groups.title: Shield Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the Marauder shield regenerates.

groups.title: Weapon Handling
groups.description: When in cover there are variables that can suppress actions when their cooldown expires, keeping them in cover for extended periods of time.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the Marauder's elbow of death attack.

groups.title: Ally Buffing
groups.description: The Marauder can buff cannibals and husks to give them armor plating that can deflect some of their incoming damage.

groups.title: Damage Evasion
groups.description: Pawns will perform evasive maneuvers when taking incoming damage. Once a damage threshold is reached in a certain amount of time, the pawn will perform a dodge.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Nemesis.title: Nemesis
Nemesis.intro: These settings affect the Cerberus Nemesis, a mobile sniper with a powerful Raptor.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Shields
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit's shields will deflect before health can be damaged.

groups.title: Shield Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the Nemesis shield regenerates.

groups.title: Sniping
groups.description: Defines how the Nemesis uses it's raptor. Aim delay is the length of time the laser tracks you before firing, while tracking duration seems to be how long the Nemesis looks at you.

groups.title: Weapon Handling
groups.description: When in cover there are variables that can suppress actions when their cooldown expires, keeping them in cover for extended periods of time.

groups.title: Damage Evasion
groups.description: Pawns will perform evasive maneuvers when taking incoming damage. Once a damage threshold is reached in a certain amount of time, the pawn will perform a dodge.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Phantom.title: Phantom
Phantom.intro: These settings affect the Cerberus Phantom, an agile enemy with a deadly hand cannon, instant-kill sword and a cloak.

groups.title: Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Barriers
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit's barriers will deflect before health can be damaged.

groups.title: Barrier Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the phantom barrier regenerates.

groups.title: Cloaking Health Percent
groups.description: Sets the amount of health a phantom must be under before it can use cloak. 0 is 0% (can't use it) and 1 is 100% (can always use it, even with barriers).

groups.title: Sync Kill Chance
groups.description: Sets the chance the Phantom will perform a sync kill (instant kill) if you are in range following a melee attack.

groups.title: Aggressive Mode
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the "aggressive" state of the Phantom, where it tries to close the distance so it can attack with its sword.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the standard sword slash attack.

groups.title: Weapon Handling
groups.description: When in cover there are variables that can suppress actions when their cooldown expires, keeping them in cover for extended periods of time.

groups.title: Damage Evasion
groups.description: Pawns will perform evasive maneuvers when taking incoming damage. The phantom uses two dodges, a standard evasion for damage and a shield for powers. Both significantly reduce incoming damage while the animation is active.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Praetorian.title: Praetorian
Praetorian.intro: These settings affect the Praetorian, a boss tier unit that can launch a barrage of long and short range attacks. It is incredibly lethal in melee range.

groups.title: Armor
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Barriers
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit's barriers will deflect before health can be damaged.

groups.title: Barrier Regeneration
groups.description: Defines how the Praetorian barrier regenerates. This applies to both standard and possessed.

groups.title: Possession Bonuses
groups.description: Sets the bonuses the Praetorian gets when becoming possessed. The possession barrier is a bonus to the normal one. By default the Praetorian does not get additional barriers.

groups.title: Laser Attack
groups.description: Sets stats for the laser attack.

groups.title: Shield Cooldown
groups.description: The bubble shield defends the Praetorian against all powers and grenades for a short duration and negates some damage.

groups.title: Possessed Missile Attack
groups.description: The Possessess Praetorian missiles are homing missiles that quickly drain your health. If cover is not taken, death soon follows this attack.

groups.title: Leap Attack
groups.description: The leap attack quickly closes distance and staggers all in its path.

groups.title: Armor Pieces
groups.description: Armor pieces on the Praetorian can be destroyed, leaving more exposed areas vulnerable.

groups.title: Melee Attack Interval
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the stab attack.

groups.title: Sync Kill Chance
groups.description: Sets the chance the Praetorian will perform a sync kill (instant kill) if you are in range following a melee attack. Since the praetorian melee staggers, it often gets multiple chances, making sync kills very easy to obtain.

groups.title: Praetorian Breach
groups.description: If the Praetorian receives enough damage in a small amount of time, it will be knocked spinning. This releases pawns from the Praetorian sync kill.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Ravager.title: Ravager
Ravager.intro: These settings affect the Ravager, a long range reaper support unit with swarmers and powerful rockets.

groups.title: Armor & Sack Health
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death, as well as the strength of the Ravager sack.

groups.title: Sack Burst
groups.description: Sets what sacks bursting on the Ravager does.

groups.title: Sack Swarmers
groups.description: Sets how many swarmers are in a sack that appear when the sack is burst.

groups.title: Weapon Behavior
groups.description: When the AI uses a weapon it can have a forced period of time where the weapon cannot be fired again. This time changes if the weapon is fired while moving.

groups.title: Swarmers
groups.description: Attributes for the Swarmer units.

groups.title: Swarmer Spawn Interval
groups.description: Defines how swarmers spawn outside of a Sack burst.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

Scion.title: Scion
Scion.intro: These settings affect the Scion, a slow moving Collector unit with a deadly arm cannon and suppressing grenades when possessed.

groups.title: Armor
groups.description: Sets how much damage this unit can take before death.

groups.title: Shoulder Sack
groups.description: Stats for when the shoulder sack is broken on the Scion.

groups.title: Scion Cannon DoT
groups.description: Defines the damage over time (DoT) length for Scion cannon. During this time shields will not automatically restore.

groups.title: Possession Bonuses
groups.description: Sets the bonuses the Scion gets when becoming possessed

groups.title: Possession Barrier Regeneration
groups.description: Defines the regeneration of the Possessed Scion's barrier. It does not seem to regenerate in game however. This stat might be removed in the future.

groups.title: Weapon Behavior
groups.description: When the AI uses a weapon it can have a forced period of time where the weapon cannot be fired again.

groups.title: Possession Grenades
groups.description: Sets stats about the Possessed Scion grenades.

groups.title: Melee Interval
groups.description: Sets the cooldown for the arm swing melee attack. Since this attack is very slow this stat does not have much effect.

groups.title: Scion Breach
groups.description: If the Scion receives enough damage in a small amount of time, it will be knocked back. This releases pawns from the Scion sync kill.

groups.title: Sync Kill Chance
groups.description: Sets the chance the Scion will perform a sync kill (instant kill) if you are in range following a melee attack.

groups.title: Stagger Resistance
groups.description: Pawns have a built-in resistance to force effects such as incoming weapon fire and projectiles. The amount of incoming force determines the severity of the impact effect, from a simple movement change to a few seconds of knockback.

enemyStats._levelsNote: The lobby's own names for DO_Level1..4. Authored rather than read because the game holds them only as TLK strings behind the challenge banners. A level with no entry is shown as "Level n", which is what a fifth difficulty would get until somebody named it.

waveBaseClass.note: Factions are its descendants, found by walking SuperClass. Never list them.

waveIndex.note: The wave number comes from here, never from the instance name.

matchSettings.usedBy: maplist editor, faction picker, difficulty picker

enemyTypes.note: Second gate on faction reachability, alongside WaveTypes.

challengeTypes.note: ID + 1 = DO_Level<n>. Positional, declared nowhere in the game - a convention, not a lookup.

mpMapNames.note: Recognised only so it is left alone: stale relative to AvailableMaps, and written with indexed assignment.

difficultyData.note: Matched across every section - no handler class is named, which is why it found single-player's fifth level for free. Never count to four.
